register.labelZh: TEST 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: test for 和 test somebody/something for something 可以幫助你說明醫生、化驗所和安全人員正在檢查甚麼。；test somebody out 可以表示讓某人實際完成一項工作,從而了解其能力和表現。；在全面採用應用程式、計劃、食譜、工具或方法前,可以用 test something out 表示先行試用。；TEST 片語動詞可以幫助你分辨:檢查某個問題是否存在、考察某人的能力,以及試用某事物是否有效。
register.summaryEn: Test for and test somebody/something for something help you explain what doctors, laboratories and safety workers are trying to find. Test somebody out lets you explain that a person is given a real task so that others can see how well they perform. Test something out is useful when an app, plan, recipe, tool or method is tried before it is used more widely. The TEST family helps you distinguish between looking for a possible problem, checking a person’s ability and trying a thing to see whether it works.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；test somebody out 和 test something out 本身已是完整表達。使用 him、her、it 或 them 時,把代名詞放在 TEST 和 OUT 中間:test him outtest it outduring a shift、on a class 或 by giving somebody a task 等部分只補充情境、對象或方法,並不是固定表達的一部分。；沒有說明受檢的人或事物時,可使用 test for something;有說明受檢對象時,則使用 testsomebody/something for something。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Test somebody out and test something out are complete expressions. With him, her, it or them, place the word between TEST and OUT: test him out test it out Extra parts such as during a shift, on a class or by giving somebody a task only add details. They are not fixed parts of the expression. Use test for something when the person or thing being checked is not named. Use test somebody/something for something when it is named. They are testing for oil. They tested the water for lead.
